mechanism: Chlorthalidone causes hypokalemia and sodium depletion which can potentiate selegiline's sympathomimetic effects and increase risk of hypertensive episodes; selegiline's MAOI activity at higher doses may interact with chlorthalidone's cardiovascular effects.
action: Monitor blood pressure closely, maintain electrolyte levels (especially potassium), and use lowest effective selegiline dose; consider alternative antihypertensive if feasible.
